description.en-US:
DegenFeed brings together all your decentralized social networks in one place. Follow what matters across Nostr, Farcaster, Lens, Bluesky, and more — all from a single unified feed.

• UNIFIED FEED — Aggregate posts from Nostr, Farcaster, Lens, Bluesky, Mastodon, Threads, and RSS into one scrollable timeline.
• CROSS-PROTOCOL COMPOSER — Write once, publish everywhere. Compose a post and syndicate it across all your connected protocols.
• REAL-TIME NOTIFICATIONS — Get push notifications for mentions, replies, and likes across every network.
• DISCOVER — Find trending content and creators across the decentralized web.
• CRYPTO-NATIVE — Connect with your wallet, verify your on-chain identity, and engage with the degen community.
• PRIVACY FIRST — No central server stores your data. Your keys, your content, your rules.
• CUSTOM FEEDS — Build custom feeds from any combination of protocols, topics, and creators.

DegenFeed is the essential client for the decentralized social web. Whether you're a degen trader, a crypto native, or just tired of walled gardens, DegenFeed puts you back in control.
